actors.title: Devex Jobs Scraper — Complete Source Descriptions
actors.description: Search international-development and NGO jobs from Devex with complete source descriptions, locations and application links. Supports explicit checks of supplied job URLs; use its own input fields.

inputSchema.title: Devex complete-description scraper input
inputSchema.description: Discovers public Devex jobs with Camoufox through Apify Residential. No model API key is required. Only v3 canonical narratives proven by a recognized metadata boundary or a clean selector-node end are emitted.

keyword.title: Keyword / topic
keyword.description: Optional conservative source-card filter. Every keyword term must occur in the visible listing-card text.

location.title: Location
location.description: Optional conservative source-card location filter. The supplied text must occur in the visible listing card.

postedWithin.title: Posted within
postedWithin.description: Keep only jobs published inside this window. Use any for no date filter, or a duration — 3d, 2w, 6m. Jobs the source gave no date for are dropped rather than guessed at.

jobUrls.title: Alive-check: Devex job URLs
jobUrls.description: Exact canonical public Devex detail URLs ending in a numeric job id. Query URLs and subpaths are rejected. When present, listing discovery is skipped and liveness is false for explicit closure, true only for a visible enabled apply control, otherwise null.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Number of complete job records or alive-check verdicts to return. Default 3; up to 10 complete detail pages per run.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Residential is required for canonical Devex listing and detail pages. Direct/datacenter requests are rejected by the source.

actors.title: Tecnoempleo Scraper — 2,400+ Spain IT Jobs, Salaries & Empleo
actors.description: Find Spanish IT and developer jobs with full descriptions, employer, location, salary and apply links. Uses its own keyword, province, remote and category controls.

inputSchema.title: Tecnoempleo Scraper input
inputSchema.description: Scrape live IT & tech job postings from Tecnoempleo.com, Spain's specialist tech job board. Crawls the site's HTML listing pages (thousands of live offers) with optional province, work-modality, category and keyword filters — far beyond the RSS feed's ~80-item cap. See README for full docs.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Optional keyword. Sent to Tecnoempleo's own search (so it narrows the crawl to matching offers) and also applied client-side (case-insensitive) against the title, company, description snippet and technology tags. Leave empty to return all listings.

province.title: Province
province.description: Optional Spanish province name to filter by (e.g. 'Madrid', 'Barcelona', 'Valencia', 'Malaga'). Accent- and case-insensitive; resolved live against Tecnoempleo's own province list, so it always matches the site's current options. Unrecognised names are ignored (the run is not filtered by province).

remote.title: Work modality
remote.description: Filter by work arrangement: 'remote' (100% en remoto), 'hybrid' (híbrido) or 'on-site' (presencial). 'any' (default) returns all.

category.title: Professional category
category.description: Optional professional-function / category name to filter by (e.g. 'Programador', 'Analista', 'DevOps', 'Business Intelligence'). Accent- and case-insensitive; resolved live against Tecnoempleo's own category list. Unrecognised names are ignored.

includeDescription.title: Legacy detail toggle (ignored)
includeDescription.description: Deprecated compatibility input. The Actor always fetches each detail page and returns the full description plus structured salary; false is ignored.

titleExclude.title: Title must NOT contain
titleExclude.description: Skip listings whose title contains any of these case-insensitive terms.

companyExclude.title: Company must NOT contain
companyExclude.description: Skip listings whose company name contains any of these case-insensitive terms.

postedWithin.title: Posted within
postedWithin.description: Keep only jobs published inside this window. Use any for no date filter, or a duration — 1h, 24h, 3d, 2w, 6m. Jobs the source published no date for are kept rather than dropped. Based on the posting date shown by Tecnoempleo. Replaces postedSince, still accepted for existing integrations.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of postings to return. Thanks to HTML pagination this can go well beyond the RSS feed's ~80-item cap (thousands of listings are available). Set 0 for no limit (bounded only by the total matching offers).

cacheTtlSeconds.sectionDescription: Technical run settings. Defaults work for most use cases.
cacheTtlSeconds.title: Cache TTL (seconds)
cacheTtlSeconds.description: Reuses fetched listing/detail pages for this many seconds so rapid re-runs don't hit Tecnoempleo again. Set 0 to always fetch live.
